title: Add browser-level dashboard smoke for local control-plane mode
description: Automate local dashboard smoke for core lab routes and assert no outbound AWS dependencies are required when NEXT_PUBLIC_PLEXUS_BACKEND=local.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Starting browser-level local-control-plane smoke implementation. Goal: prove local dashboard pages render against localhost GraphQL and fail on any hosted AWS/AppSync/Cognito/S3 network calls.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented local browser smoke proof for core MVP routes. The script now verifies /lab/items/nira-demo-item-1, /lab/scorecards, /lab/evaluations, /lab/reports, and /lab/procedures against localhost dashboard and local GraphQL. It captures screenshots, verifies demo user/account plus Nira item/scorecard visibility, checks local GraphQL prediction ScoreResult readback, and fails on any non-local hosted HTTP request, hosted AWS/AppSync/Cognito/S3 request, or browser console error. Latest verification passed cleanly.
